nodes.summary: The coercion from extended nonnegative reals to extended reals commutes with bounded infima. For any set `s` (empty or not) and `f : ι → [0, ∞]`, the infimum of `f` over `s` computed in `[0, ∞]` and then coerced agrees with the infimum of the coerced values computed in `EReal`; both are `∞` when `s` is empty.
nodes.title: The coercion from extended nonnegative reals to extended reals commutes with bounded infima

nodes.summary: If `I` is a good rate function, `F` is continuous and `Y` is Hausdorff, then for every `y` with `J(y) < ∞` there is `x` with `F x = y` and `I x = J y`, where `J = pushforwardRate F I`. The minimiser exists because the fibre `F⁻¹{y}` is closed and meets a compact sub-level set of the lower semicontinuous `I`.
nodes.title: The contraction infimum is attained

nodes.summary: The infimum of `I` over `F⁻¹(C)` equals the infimum over `C` of the push-forward rate function `J(y) = inf_{F x = y} I x`, both computed in `EReal`. This is the identity behind both bounds of the contraction principle.
nodes.title: Infimum over a preimage

nodes.summary: If `I` is a good rate function on `X`, `F : X → Y` is continuous and `Y` is Hausdorff, then `J(y) = inf_{F x = y} I x` is lower semicontinuous with compact finite sub-level sets (Varadhan, *Large Deviations*, NYU lecture notes, 2010, Section 2, Theorem 2.7).
nodes.title: The push-forward of a good rate function is a good rate function

nodes.summary: For `F : X → Y` and `I : X → [0, ∞]`, the function `J(y) = inf { I(x) : F(x) = y }`, which is `∞` off the range of `F`. It is the rate function of the contraction principle (Varadhan, *Large Deviations*, NYU lecture notes, 2010, Section 2, Theorem 2.7).
nodes.title: Push-forward rate function

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space with a $\sigma$-algebra containing the open sets, let $Y$ be a Hausdorff space with its Borel $\sigma$-algebra, and let $F : X \to Y$ be continuous. If the measures $(\mu_n)$ on $X$ satisfy the large deviation principle with a good rate function $I$, then the image measures $(F_* \mu_n)$ satisfy the large deviation principle on $Y$ with the good rate function
nodes.title: Contraction principle

nodes.summary: For a good rate function `I`, continuous `F` and Hausdorff `Y`, the sub-level set `{J ≤ a}` of `J = pushforwardRate F I` at a finite level `a` is the image `F({I ≤ a})`. (At `a = ∞` the left side is all of `Y` while the right side is the range of `F`.)
nodes.title: Sub-level sets of the push-forward rate
